en: The image is of an illustrated postcard featuring a large, historic castle with two prominent towers and an extensive building complex, situated beside a river or body of water. The building rests on a slight hill or elevated area surrounded by trees. At the top, in red Gothic-style script, is the text 'Schloß Rochlitz i. Sa.' The sky is clear with a gradient from blue to a gentle dusk or dawn light.
